About Syd Life AI 
 We build life quality infrastructure that compounds validated research and action into better living .
 Syd , our companion , draws on 2.7 million+ peer-reviewed studies and 14.3 billion+ person-years of longitudinal data , and turns that evidence into action across nine dimensions of life quality . Every recommendation traces back to its evidence . Syd is available in 30 languages and deployed in 26 countries .
 Privacy and security sit at the centre of how we build : SOC 2 , ISO 27001 , ISO 42001 , GDPR and HIPAA .
 Our goal is to give people their agency back . We hire people who already act that way : you choose the problem , test the idea against the evidence and measure the impact . Small remote team , real ownership from your first week , consulting agreements with equity .
 The role 
 Syd is looking for a hands-on QA engineer to build and own a reliable testing process for our iOS and Android app . You will combine automation with focused manual testing to catch issues earlier , make releases more dependable and improve the member experience . The role covers the whole app , including onboarding , core member journeys , AI conversations , activity recommendations and notifications . Our current app languages are English , Japanese and Arabic .
 What you bring 

• Practical experience testing mobile apps on both iOS and Android .

• Experience building and maintaining automated tests , with programming skills sufficient to investigate failures and keep the test suite dependable .

• Experience with API testing , version control and running tests within continuous integration and release workflows .

• Strong exploratory testing skills and judgement about which checks to automate and which need human review .

• Clear written English for test plans , bug reports and communication with the team .

• The ability to prioritise work , explain risks and own a QA process with limited supervision .

 What you will do 

• Map critical member journeys and build a practical testing strategy based on member impact and release risk .

• Build and maintain automated smoke and regression tests for critical mobile journeys and APIs .

• Run exploratory and regression testing on real iOS and Android devices .

• Test AI conversations through repeatable scenarios and agreed quality criteria .

• Check localisation across English , Japanese and Arabic , including right-to-left layouts .

• Log clear , reproducible issues in Jira and provide concise release-readiness reports .

 Terms 
 Remote , open to candidates anywhere in the world . Consulting agreement with equity .
 How to apply 
 Apply at careers.syd.life/careers/qa-engineer . Every candidate completes an online assessment and a 48-hour task before any interview .
